result.stdout:
dotnet prolog — run and analyze Prolog on .NET

Usage:
  dotnet prolog run [--mode extended|strict-iso|modern] <file.pl>
      consult a file and run its goals
  dotnet prolog lint [--mode extended|strict-iso|modern] [--profile semantic|covington]
      [--warnings-as-errors] <file.pl>...
      analyze source without consulting it or executing directives

Language modes:
  extended     ISO plus the DotProlog extensions (default)
  strict-iso   only the standardized ISO/IEC 13211 surface
  modern       extended, with double_quotes starting at chars
